app.metaDescripcion: ColdCare: temperature monitoring, alerts and history for refrigerated medicines.

login.eslogan: Protect every dose. At every degree.
login.descripcion: Monitor your equipment, receive timely alerts and keep reliable records for every review.
login.subtitulo: Sign in with your authorised account.
login.marcaEslogan: Protect every dose. At every degree.
login.marcaDescripcion: Monitor your equipment, receive timely alerts and keep traceable records for every review.
login.errorDemasiadosIntentos: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.errorServidor: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
login.avisoSeguridadPie: Protected access with in-transit encryption and volatile in-memory token authentication.
login.sesionCerradaRecarga: For your security, the session closes when the page reloads. Please sign in again.
login.googleNoAutorizado: Your Google account has no access to ColdCare. Ask the administrator to register it.
login.googleNoDisponible: Google sign-in is not available right now.
login.cuentasAdministrador: No account? Ask your pharmacy administrator.

detalle.normal: Temperature is within the expected 2–8 °C range
detalle.riesgo_preventivo: Approaching the limit: keep an eye on the refrigerator
detalle.excursion_critica: Temperature is outside the 2–8 °C range. Check the refrigerator.

ia.sinInferencia: No AI inference for this reading

dashboard.descripcion: Temperature, conditions and alerts that need attention.
dashboard.fallaSensor: No temperature reading. Check the sensor.
dashboard.sinLecturaDisponible: No reading is available for this metric.
dashboard.sinClasificacion: No temperature reading is available to calculate risk.
dashboard.riesgoUltimaLectura: Risk from the last reading. Wait for new data to confirm the current state.
dashboard.excursionConfirmada: Temperature is outside the expected 2–8 °C range.
dashboard.clasificacionIaDivergente: Automatic analysis suggests reviewing this reading, but temperature remains within range. No excursion is confirmed.
dashboard.puertaHuboApertura: Opened for {{segundos}} s since the previous reading.
dashboard.esperandoDetalle: The dashboard updates automatically when a new device reading arrives.
dashboard.lecturasRecientesAyuda: Latest records in the selected period.
dashboard.lecturaSobreEscala: Reading exceeds the indicator scale (0–10 °C). Actual value: {{temperatura}} °C.
dashboard.lecturaBajoEscala: Reading is below the indicator scale (0 °C). Actual value: {{temperatura}} °C.
dashboard.graficaEtiqueta: Line chart: internal and ambient temperature for the last {{n}} readings, with the 2–8 °C storage range marked
dashboard.estadoIoTDetalle: Connection, sensor faults, and local sync. This status is separate from thermal risk.
dashboard.alertaSilencio: No reports since {{fecha}}. The {{segundos}}s threshold was exceeded.
dashboard.nuncaReporto: This device has not sent its first report yet.
dashboard.puertaSuperaUmbral: Open for more than {{segundos}}s. Check the door.
dashboard.demoAyuda: Local scenarios for checking alerts and recovery. No data is sent to IoT devices.
dashboard.demoBufferLleno: Simulate full buffer and data loss
dashboard.demoAplicado: Scenario applied. Dashboard now shows the new state.
dashboard.demoError: Could not apply scenario. Try again.

demo.descripcionBadge: Simulated data: the application runs without a server connection
demo.accesoDetalle: Explore the system with simulated data.
demo.avisoDetalle: Demo mode: no temperature, alert or verification on this screen comes from a real refrigerator.

historial.descripcion: Find temperatures by device, risk level, and date range.
historial.sinResultados: No readings match the selected filters.
historial.errorCargar: We couldn't load readings. Try again.
historial.errorTabla: Readings are hidden because we couldn't load the information.
historial.rangoInvalido: The "from" date cannot be later than the "to" date.
historial.evidenciaNoDisponible: Classification evidence is not available for this reading.
historial.evidenciaDemo: Simulated example. This is not real model evidence or a validated measurement.

alertas.descripcion: Review notices about conditions that may need attention.
alertas.conflictoEstado: This alert was already updated by someone else. The list was refreshed with its current status.
alertas.sinAlertas: There are no alerts on record yet.
alertas.sinRevisadas: There are no alerts marked as reviewed.
alertas.sinAtendidas: There are no alerts with a recorded action.
alertas.errorCargar: We couldn't load alerts. Try again.
alertas.errorTabla: Alerts are hidden because we couldn't load the information.
alertas.rectificarAyuda: The original action is not modified: a new version is added with its reason.
alertas.motivoRectificacionAyuda: 10 to 500 characters. It stays in the history next to the correction.

errorRectificacion.conflicto: Someone already amended this action. The timeline was refreshed.
errorRectificacion.prohibido: Only the action's author or a pharmacist can amend it.
errorRectificacion.error: The amendment could not be saved. Please try again.

alertas.soloFarmaceutico: Only pharmacy staff can mark an alert as reviewed.
alertas.descripcionAccionPlaceholder: E.g. vials were relocated and the thermostat set to 5 °C
alertas.descripcionAccionAyuda: Describe what was done in response to the alert. It will appear in the history.

trazabilidad.descripcion: Check readings and actions for possible later changes.
trazabilidad.cadenaIntegraDetalle: The check found no later changes in the {{n}} records reviewed.
trazabilidad.cadenaRotaDetalle: A difference was detected in record #{{n}}. Notify the administrator and keep the information for review.
trazabilidad.cadenaExplicacion: ColdCare checks related readings and actions. If it finds a later change, it identifies the record for review.
trazabilidad.selloAyuda: Technical detail about the record's cryptographic verification
trazabilidad.cadenaComprometida: An inconsistency was detected in the history
trazabilidad.cadenaComprometidaDetalle: Review the flagged record and retain the information for investigation.
trazabilidad.rupturaAislada: Isolated break: the chain is verifiable again
trazabilidad.rupturaAisladaDetalle: {{n}} historical alteration(s) isolated by an administrator. The chain is intact since {{fecha}}
trazabilidad.discrepancia_payload_alterado: Content modified after it was recorded
trazabilidad.discrepancia_enlace_roto: Link to the previous record is broken
trazabilidad.alcanceVerificacion: This check only certifies that stored records were not altered after creation and, if a break exists, where it occurred. It is not a sanitary, regulatory or DIGEMID compliance certification of how the medicines were stored.
trazabilidad.confirmarAislar: This record will be marked as isolated and excluded from the verifiable chain. The action is audited and cannot be undone.
trazabilidad.hastaOpcional: Optional. Leave blank to check through now.
trazabilidad.rangoInvalido: The selected range is invalid: "from" cannot be later than "to".
trazabilidad.segmentoIntegro: No changes detected in this period
trazabilidad.segmentoRoto: A change was detected in this period

reportes.descripcion: Review and download readings, alerts and actions for internal review.
reportes.notaFormatos: CSV is easy to review and print. JSON retains technical data, including verification seals.
reportes.sinReporte: Set the period and generate a report to see the summary.
reportes.errorGenerar: The report could not be generated.
reportes.notaPdf: The PDF summarizes the selected period and integrity check. It may support internal review; it does not replace official records or documents.
reportes.errorRangoInvertido: The start date is after the end date. Fix the period.
reportes.errorPeriodoExcesivo: The period cannot exceed {{max}} days. Split the report into shorter ranges.
reportes.errorCuota: Too many reports in a row. Wait a minute before generating again.
reportes.sinReporteDetalle: Pick a period and generate the report to see the summary and download it as PDF, CSV or JSON.

auditoria.descripcion: Critical actions recorded in the system
auditoria.ayudaAccion: Search by the action name or exact action code.
auditoria.bloqueosTemporales_one: {{count}} temporary access lock recorded. This does not confirm an attack.
auditoria.bloqueosTemporales_other: {{count}} temporary access locks recorded. This does not confirm an attack.
auditoria.sinRegistros: There are no recorded actions yet.

usuarios.ultimoAdmin: This is the last active administrator: the system would be left without administration.
usuarios.errorRbac: Not allowed: it is your own account or no active administrator would remain.
usuarios.descripcion: Control who can access the system and what each role can do
usuarios.errorDuplicado: A user with that email already exists.
usuarios.confirmarDesactivar: Deactivate {{nombre}}? They will no longer be able to sign in, and their identity will be hidden in reports (right to be forgotten, Law No. 29733). The audit trail remains intact.
usuarios.confirmarCambiarRol: Change {{nombre}}'s role? The change takes effect immediately, and the new role's permissions will apply.
usuarios.passwordTemporalDetalle: Give it to {{nombre}} through a secure channel. It is shown only once and must be changed at sign-in.
usuarios.restablecerConfirmar: {{nombre}}'s open sessions will end and the current password will stop working.
usuarios.reactivarConfirmar: {{nombre}} will regain access with a temporary password.

privacidad.descripcion: Under Law No. 29733 on Personal Data Protection, we need your explicit consent to process your data within the monitoring system. You must accept to continue; if you decline, your session will be closed.
privacidad.errorAceptar: Your consent could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.

dispositivos.descripcion: Manage each device code, sensors, connection, local buffer, calibration validity, and lifecycle.
dispositivos.confirmarBaja: Decommission device {{id}}? The reading and traceability history remains intact.
dispositivos.instalacionAviso: A location change is recorded in the history; the previous location is not lost.
dispositivos.responsableAviso: This contact receives critical excursion alerts by email and, if the SMS channel is enabled, by text message.
dispositivos.registroAyuda: The code identifies the ESP32 node. It must be unique and remains stable when sensors are replaced.
dispositivos.codigoUnicoAyuda: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens; this identifier appears on readings as device_id.
dispositivos.equipoRegistrado: Device registered. Connection and credential remain pending until the node is configured.
dispositivos.credencialRevocada: Credential revoked. The device loses broker access.
dispositivos.simulacionSoloDemo: {{id}} · Local sample scenarios. No ESP32, MQTT, or EMQX connection is made.
dispositivos.motivoCredencialAyuda: Recorded in the audit log (max. 200 characters).
dispositivos.rotarCredencialDescripcion: A new token will be issued for {{id}} and the previous one will stop working.
dispositivos.revocarCredencialDescripcion: Revoke the MQTT credential of {{id}}? The device loses access until it receives a new credential.
dispositivos.tokenAdvertencia: Copy it now and flash it to the node: it will not be shown again and the system only keeps its hash.
dispositivos.sesionBrokerCerrada: The broker closed the device's previous session.
dispositivos.sesionBrokerNoCerrada: The broker did not confirm closing the previous session: check EMQX.
dispositivos.sesionBrokerSinApi: Broker API not configured: the previous session will end when the device reconnects.
dispositivos.codigoInvalido: Invalid code: use only letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore (max. 50).

comunes.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
comunes.errorPantallaTitulo: This screen could not be displayed
comunes.errorPantallaDetalle: Reload to try again. If the problem continues, contact your administrator.
comunes.sesionExpirada: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
comunes.sinPermiso: You do not have permission to view this section.
comunes.verDatosGrafica: View the chart data as a table

metricasIA.descripcion: Review examples of how the model assigns a risk level to each reading.
metricasIA.definicionF1: Summarizes how the model identifies situations and avoids incorrect classifications, considering the number of cases in each group.
metricasIA.avisoDatosNoReportables: Illustrative sample with synthetic data. It is not a validated evaluation and cannot support claims about real classifier performance.
metricasIA.contextoNoVerificado: Data origin and test-set evidence still need confirmation. The threshold is not compared.
metricasIA.contextoUmbral: The prototype criterion is {{umbral}} or higher. This result does not show the refrigerator's current status.
metricasIA.definicionExactitud: Share of evaluated cases the model classified correctly.
metricasIA.definicionDeteccionCritica: Share of actual critical excursion cases identified by the model.
metricasIA.notaEvaluacion: Classifier results on a test set. These are not temperature readings or daily activity from the pharmacy.
metricasIA.porClaseAyuda: Compare how each risk level was classified in the evaluated cases.
metricasIA.definicionesTabla: Precision: of the cases the model assigned to a situation, how many matched. Detection: of the actual cases in that situation, how many it identified. F1 summarizes both measures. Cases evaluated is the count used for each row.
metricasIA.comoSeEvaluoAyuda: The average uses {{folds}} data partitions separated by scenario.
metricasIA.agrupacionAyuda: Each partition groups readings by scenario to compare performance.
metricasIA.particionMuestrasValor: {{entrenamiento}} to train the model · {{prueba}} to evaluate it
metricasIA.variablesAyuda: Importance reported for each variable; these details follow the results.
metricasIA.notaImportancias: The percentage compares importance reported for each variable. It does not, on its own, indicate a cause or the probability of a situation.
metricasIA.notaReproducibilidad: These details help identify the evaluation. A random seed or fingerprint alone does not guarantee that training can be repeated exactly.
metricasIA.notaUsoProfesional: These metrics evaluate a classifier. Follow your pharmacy's procedure when responding to an alert; this result does not replace professional review.
metricasIA.noEntrenado: No evaluation is available for this model yet. Contact the administrator to review its setup.
metricasIA.errorCarga: We couldn't load the model results. Try again.
metricasIA.reglaIndependiente: Random Forest classifies Normal or Preventive risk. A critical excursion is confirmed by the independent 2–8 °C rule; it is not a model probability.

sesion.porExpirar: Your session expires in {{restante}}. Save your work.

guia.descripcion: What to check, how to respond to an alert, and where to find records.
guia.inicioDescripcion: Start with the refrigerator status. If an alert appears, review the reading and follow your pharmacy's procedure.

monitoreo.descripcion: See the latest reading and device status.

alerta.descripcion: Open Alerts to review its level and when it occurred.

historial.descripcion: Use History to review readings from another time or date.

guia.estadosTitulo: Read the temperature and its status
guia.estadosDescripcion: The status summarizes how a reading compares with the allowed range.

normal.descripcion: The reading is within the range shown for the device.

preventivo.descripcion: The reading is approaching a limit; review it before it leaves the range.

critico.descripcion: The reading is outside the allowed range. Check the refrigerator and follow your pharmacy's procedure.

guia.rangoNota: Check the allowed range in Monitoring and compare the reading with its date and time.
guia.alertaTitulo: Review the situation and record what happened
guia.alertaDescripcion: An alert shows a risk level and its related reading. Recording an action documents the response.

revisar.descripcion: Open the alert and check temperature, date, and time.

registrar.descripcion: If your role allows it, mark the alert as reviewed and note the action taken.

guia.alertaPermisos: Pharmacy technicians can record a corrective action; pharmacists can also mark an alert as reviewed. Auditors have read-only access.
guia.ejemplo: 4.3 °C is within range. A reading of 8.4 °C is outside it: review the alert, follow your pharmacy's procedure, and record the response.
guia.pantallasDescripcion: Available links depend on your role.

monitoreo.descripcion: See the latest temperature, device status, and recent readings.

alertas.descripcion: Review notices, their risk level, and when they occurred.

historial.descripcion: Find readings by device, risk level, and date range.

integridad.descripcion: Check for differences in related records; this does not replace official documents.

reportes.descripcion: Review or download a period summary of readings, alerts, and actions.

metricas.descripcion: Review the model evaluation; it does not show current temperatures.

auditoria.descripcion: See which actions were recorded and who performed them.

usuarios.descripcion: Manage staff access and permissions for each role.

dispositivos.descripcion: Review device connection, location, and calibration dates.

rango.descripcion: Temperature limits configured for checking storage conditions on a device.

preventivo.descripcion: An alert that a reading is approaching a limit, even if it is still within range.

excursion.descripcion: A period when the temperature was outside the allowed range.

integridad.descripcion: A review that can flag later differences in related readings and actions.

bpa.descripcion: Good Storage Practices. The ColdCare checklist supports internal checks but does not certify compliance.

alerta.titulo: Does an alert confirm that medicine was damaged?
alerta.respuesta: No. ColdCare shows readings and refrigerator status; it cannot determine medicine condition on its own. Follow your pharmacy's procedure.

integridad.titulo: Does the integrity check replace official records?
integridad.respuesta: No. It can help flag differences in records, but it does not replace professional review or official documents.

metricas.titulo: Do these metrics show the current temperature?
metricas.respuesta: No. They summarize how a classifier performed on test cases; they do not show current temperatures or alerts.

guia.nota: Available screens depend on your role. Actions that change records also follow your system permissions.

recuperarContrasena.subtitulo: Enter your institutional email and we will send you secure instructions to reset your access.
recuperarContrasena.exitoMensaje: If {{email}} matches an active account, you will receive a secure link to reset your password in the next few minutes.
recuperarContrasena.notaSeguridad: If your email is registered you will receive a single-use link that expires in 30 minutes.
recuperarContrasena.noDisponible: Email recovery is not available. Ask the administrator to reset your password.

restablecerContrasena.subtitulo: Set a new secure password to access thermal monitoring.
restablecerContrasena.requisitos: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
restablecerContrasena.exitoMensaje: Your password has been successfully updated. You can now sign in with your new credentials.
restablecerContrasena.tokenInvalido: The reset link is invalid or has expired.
restablecerContrasena.tokenInvalidoDetalle: The link expired or was already used. Request a new one to continue.

politica.corta: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
politica.sin_letras_y_digitos: The password must combine letters and numbers.
politica.demasiado_larga: The password is too long (72 bytes maximum).

cambiarPassword.subtitulo: Choose a password only you know.
cambiarPassword.temporal: Your password is temporary: an administrator set it. Change it to continue.
cambiarPassword.errorActual: The current password is not correct.
cambiarPassword.errorIgual: The new password must differ from the current one.

avisosTiempoReal.recuperacion: {{device}} is back in the safe range.
avisosTiempoReal.buffer_saturado: {{device}}'s local buffer is full: readings may have been lost.
avisosTiempoReal.wifi_reconexion_prolongada: {{device}} has been trying to reconnect to the network for a while.
avisosTiempoReal.config_modificada: {{device}}'s configuration was changed from its console ({{clave}}).
avisosTiempoReal.reinicio_manual: {{device}} was restarted manually from its console.
avisosTiempoReal.consola_desbloqueo_fallido: Repeated failed attempts to unlock {{device}}'s console.
avisosTiempoReal.ota_revertida: {{device}} rolled back to version {{version}}: the update failed its boot check.
